title: Gift ideas
audience: For anyone who hears the perfect gift idea in March and forgets it by December.
description: A gift idea list your AI fills as you go: ideas by person, sizes and likes, and suggestions before the next birthday.
tagline: Ideas for everyone, saved when you hear them.

## Sizes and likes

prompt.default: Use my Pinto Notes note "Gift ideas". Read it with fetch before each change. Whenever I mention something someone would like, add a row to the table with edit: Person, Occasion if I said one, Idea, Budget as a number if I gave one, and Status Idea. Keep what I learn about each person (sizes, favourite things, what they already have) under "Sizes and likes". Before a birthday, when I ask, suggest three gifts within budget that fit what's there. When I buy one, set its Status to Bought.

asks: Maja mentioned she wants a good chef's knife.
Dad's birthday is in three weeks. Ideas under 500?
Jonas wears a medium and loves anything green.
